# CaptureOCR

> CaptureOCR is a Windows screenshot, annotation, and OCR workflow tool built for Chinese/CJK mixed-text scenarios. It uses the PP-OCRv6 offline engine, supports multi-region batch recognition and structured Markdown/CSV export, and is available as a one-time purchase ($2.99) on the Microsoft Store.

- Microsoft Store: https://apps.microsoft.com/store/detail/9PBP8VBG4RJ1
- Core capabilities: multi-region batch OCR, structured Markdown/CSV export, annotation + beautify + OCR in one window
- Offline: tiny model bundled, OCR works without internet
- Not supported: scrolling capture (roadmap P1), table/vertical-text structured recognition (P2)
